earshot.bypass.on: Earshot bypassed: sounds as the game plays them
earshot.settings.title: Acoustics
earshot.settings.unavailable: Earshot's native engine didn't start, so there is nothing to set. The game log says why.
earshot.settings.status.off: Sounds play exactly as the game plays them
earshot.settings.reverb.status.off: No reverb, and no room tracing
earshot.settings.reverb.status.no_convol: This OpenAL has no convolution, so EAX plays instead
earshot.settings.voice.missing: Install Yak VC for proximity voice with these acoustics
earshot.settings.bypass.unbound: Bind Bypass (A/B) in Controls to hear the difference
earshot.settings.bypass.bound: Press %s in game to hear the difference
earshot.settings.preset.auto.tooltip: Picks a quality by this computer's cores. At any quality, the room trace uses fewer rays if it runs over its share of the CPU.
earshot.settings.preset.off.tooltip: Earshot leaves the game's sounds as they are.
earshot.settings.preset.low.tooltip: 256 rays × 4 bounces for the room, 4 times a second; one occlusion ray per sound; sound round corners within 16 blocks.
earshot.settings.preset.medium.tooltip: 1,024 rays × 8 bounces for the room, 8 times a second; five occlusion rays per sound; sound round corners within 24 blocks.
earshot.settings.preset.high.tooltip: 4,096 rays × 16 bounces for the room, 10 times a second; nine occlusion rays per sound; sound round corners within 32 blocks.
earshot.settings.preset.ultra.tooltip: 16,384 rays × 32 bounces for the room, 10 times a second; nine occlusion rays per sound; sound round corners within 48 blocks; the four loudest sounds echo off the walls around them. Up to about a core, spread over several threads.
earshot.settings.occlusion.tooltip: Blocks between you and a sound muffle it, by what they are made of: wool more than glass, stone more than wood.
earshot.settings.pathing.tooltip: A sound behind a wall comes round through the nearest opening, from that direction.
earshot.settings.reverb.auto.tooltip: Convolution where the game's OpenAL has it, else EAX.
earshot.settings.reverb.convolution.tool: Impulse responses made from the room around you, with echoes from where the walls are. About a tenth of a core.
earshot.settings.reverb.eax.tooltip: OpenAL's parametric reverb, set from the room around you. Cheaper than convolution.
earshot.settings.reverb.off.tooltip: No reverb, and no room trace.
earshot.settings.air_absorption.tooltip: Far sounds lose their highs, as they do through real air.
earshot.settings.underwater.tooltip: Everything is muffled while your head is underwater, with a watery reverb.
earshot.settings.doppler.tooltip: Sounds moving towards or away from you, or you towards them, shift in pitch.
earshot.settings.voice.tooltip: Plays Yak VC's proximity voice through Earshot, with the same acoustics as the game's sounds. Off gives it back to Yak VC's own speakers.
earshot.settings.own_voice.tooltip: Your own voice in Yak VC echoes off the room around you: a cave answers you. Only the echo, never your voice itself. For headphones; needs a Yak VC that sends your own voice.
earshot.settings.realistic_falloff.toolt: Sounds fade as they do in real air, halving every doubling of distance past two blocks, instead of the game's straight line to silence. Nearby sounds stand out more; far ones carry but stay quiet.
earshot.settings.hrtf.tooltip: The head-related transfer function used when Directional Audio is on. OpenAL Soft lists its built-in one and any .mhr files it finds. Changing it restarts the sound engine.
